title: Proceedings of the 2025 Joint Workshop of Fraunhofer IOSB and Institute for Anthropomatics, Vision and Fusion Laboratory
summary: The 2025 joint workshop of Fraunhofer IOSB and the KIT Vision and Fusion Laboratory (IES) took place in Triberg-Nussbach, Germany, from July 27th to August 2nd. During the week-long event, doctoral students presented comprehensive reports and debated key topics such as computer vision, industrial production, optimization, control theory, security, and large language models.
